responsibility: This implementation module provides the immediate terminal façade over Termbase for the Logitech/PIM compatibility stack. It forwards single-character reads, writes, and readiness tests to the currently assigned Termbase handlers, implements line-oriented string input with CR/LF termination and tab expansion, emits nul-terminated strings and linefeeds, and leaves ReadAgain as a no-op compatibility stub.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Terminal pair: it realizes the façade from Terminal.def by forwarding character I/O to Termbase, implementing line-based string input/output, and leaving ReadAgain as a no-op stub.
